title: Token Communication-Assisted Collaborative Embodied Artificial Intelligence: Concepts, Framework, and Opportunities
title_zh: 令牌通信辅助的协作具身人工智能：概念、框架与机遇

paragraphs.en: Collaborative embodied artificial intelligence (CEAI) enables multiple physical agents to perceive, reason, and act cooperatively in dynamic environments. Effective communication is essential for CEAI, yet CEAI agents must exchange not only large multimodal observations but also task-relevant insights, intents, and interactive information over long horizons. This article investigates token communication (TokCom) as a native intelligence interface for CEAI, in which tokens serve jointly as compact semantic carriers for communication and fundamental inference units for generative foundation models (GFMs). We first discuss how TokCom supports insight sharing, intent alignment, and interactive control among embodied agents. We then propose a TokCom-assisted CEAI framework driven by a task-adaptive communication protocol. Comprising a compact codebook, syntax rules, and contextual examples, this protocol guides GFM-based transceivers to distill messages into compact tokens and reconstruct them after wireless transmission. A case study on collaborative object transport demonstrates that the proposed TokCom framework substantially reduces the source payload bit consumption while preserving task efficiency and showing robustness under noisy channels. Finally, we outline future research directions.
paragraphs.zh: 协作具身人工智能（CEAI）使多个物理智能体能够在动态环境中协同感知、推理和行动。 有效的通信对 CEAI 至关重要，但 CEAI 智能体不仅需要交换大规模的多模态观测数据，还需要在长时间跨度内传递与任务相关的洞察、意图和交互信息。 本文研究了令牌通信（TokCom）作为 CEAI 的原生智能接口，其中令牌既作为通信的紧凑语义载体，也作为生成式基础模型（GFM）的基本推理单元。 我们首先探讨了 TokCom 如何支持具身智能体之间的洞察共享、意图对齐和交互控制。 接着，我们提出了一种由任务自适应通信协议驱动的 TokCom 辅助 CEAI 框架。 该协议包含一个紧凑的码本、句法规则和上下文示例，指导基于 GFM 的收发器将消息提炼为紧凑的令牌，并在无线传输后重新构建。 一项关于协作物体运输的案例研究表明，所提出的 TokCom 框架在保持任务效率的同时显著减少了源端有效载荷的比特消耗，并展现出在噪声信道下的鲁棒性。 最后，我们概述了未来的研究方向。

paragraphs.en: Collaborative embodied artificial intelligence (CEAI) represents a decentralized paradigm in which multiple physical agents operate within a shared environment, coordinating their actions to achieve common goals [ 1 ] . Due to partial observability and inherent physical constraints of individual agents, communication is essential for them to exchange perceptions and intents, enabling coordinated actions to effectively accomplish complex tasks [ 2 , 3 ] . To fulfill the vision of CEAI, next-generation wireless systems must evolve beyond supporting conventional human-to-human (H2H) communication to enable intelligent multi-agent communication, reasoning, and coordination [ 4 ] .

paragraphs.en: However, existing communication paradigms are insufficient to support the demands of CEAI. In particular, conventional communication systems are designed to ensure reliable bit-level transmissions, which become inefficient for embodied agents, as faithfully transmitting their continuously collected multimodal raw data would consume excessive bandwidth and incur high latency [ 5 ] . Semantic communication (SemCom) alleviates part of this burden by extracting and transmitting task-relevant meaning, thereby reducing redundant source information before transmission [ 6 ] . Nevertheless, existing SemCom systems are developed for predefined tasks. This makes it difficult to apply them directly to dynamic CEAI scenarios, in which embodied agents must continuously transform multimodal observations into compact messages and exchange them to support general, adaptive, and long-horizon multi-agent collaboration. In such settings, communication is not limited to conveying extracted data semantics, but also involves sharing intentions, task states, environmental changes, requests, and coordination constraints over long interaction horizons.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有的通信范式不足以支持 CEAI 的需求。 特别是，传统通信系统旨在确保可靠的比特级传输，但对于具身智能体而言，这种方式效率低下，因为忠实地传输其持续收集的多模态原始数据会消耗过多的带宽并导致高延迟 [ 5 ] 。 语义通信（SemCom）通过提取和传输任务相关的含义来减轻部分负担，从而在传输前减少冗余的源信息 [ 6 ] 。 然而，现有的 SemCom 系统是为预定义任务而开发的。 这使得它们难以直接应用于动态的 CEAI 场景，在这些场景中，具身智能体必须持续地将多模态观察转化为紧凑的消息并进行交换，以支持通用、自适应且长期规划的多智能体协作。 在此类设定中，通信不仅限于传递提取出的数据语义，还涉及在长期的交互过程中共享意图、任务状态、环境变化、请求以及协调约束。

paragraphs.en: Driven by the rapid evolution of generative foundation models (GFMs) for artificial intelligence (AI)-native wireless systems, token communication (TokCom) has become a potential approach to enable CEAI [ 7 ] . In this paradigm, tokens serve concurrently as compact carriers of multimodal semantics and as the fundamental inference units of GFMs. This dual role is particularly appealing for CEAI. On the one hand, as compact semantic carriers, tokens encode heterogeneous data from various modalities into a unified format, providing a common representation that streamlines information transmission among embodied agents. On the other hand, as the fundamental inference units of GFMs, they contain essential semantics that can be directly processed for reasoning, so that low-level exchanges can support intention alignment, plan negotiation, and collaborative decision-making. In this sense, TokCom goes beyond simple data representation and serves as a native intelligence interface for multi-agent collaboration at the intelligent edge.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成式基础模型（GFMs）为人工智能（AI）原生无线系统带来的快速演进推动下，令牌通信（TokCom）已成为实现 CEAI [ 7 ] 的一种潜在方法。 在这种范式下，令牌同时充当多模态语义的紧凑载体以及 GFMs 的基本推理单元。 这种双重角色对于 CEAI 而言尤其具有吸引力。 一方面，作为紧凑的语义载体，令牌将来自不同模态的异构数据编码为统一格式，提供通用的表示形式，从而简化具身智能体之间的信息传输。 另一方面，作为 GFMs 的基本推理单元，它们包含可直接用于推理的核心语义，因此低层级的交互能够支持意图对齐、计划协商和协作决策。 从这个意义上说，TokCom 超越了简单的数据表示，成为智能边缘上多智能体协作的原生智能接口。

paragraphs.en: Despite these advantages, applying TokCom to CEAI over wireless networks presents significant challenges. First, current GFMs are inherently designed for open-ended reasoning and generation, whereas TokCom among embodied agents must be significantly more concise for specific tasks. In GFMs, tokenizers typically rely on an expansive general vocabulary, often containing on the order of 10 5 10^{5} entries. With a vocabulary size of V V , transmitting a single token index necessitates ⌈ log 2 ⁡ V ⌉ \lceil\log_{2}V\rceil source bits, corresponding to 17 17 or 18 18 bits per token when V ≈ 10 5 V\approx 10^{5} . However, for a specific embodied task, only a highly restricted subset of semantic concepts, actions, intentions, and coordination commands is typically required. Consequently, the massive generic vocabulary can be compressed into a streamlined, task-adaptive agent language, enabling agents to exchange information with significantly higher efficiency over wireless channels. Second, unlike traditional wireless systems that focus on point-to-point metrics such as bit error rate and single-shot task accuracy, CEAI prioritizes long-horizon collaborative task completion. Therefore, the performance of wireless TokCom should be evaluated by how transmitted tokens affect reasoning, coordination, and task success, rather than by token recovery accuracy alone. This calls for a paradigm shift toward effectiveness-level metrics that directly connect wireless transmission quality with the final outcomes of embodied multi-agent collaboration.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管存在这些优势，但在无线网络中将 TokCom 应用于 CEAI 仍面临重大挑战。 首先，当前的 GFM 本质上是为开放式的推理和生成而设计的，而具身智能体之间的 TokCom 必须针对特定任务做到更加简洁。 在 GFM 中，分词器通常依赖一个庞大的通用词汇表，其中往往包含约 10^5 个条目。 当词汇表大小为 V 时，传输单个词元索引需要 ⌈log₂V⌉ 位源比特；当 V ≈ 10^5 时，这相当于每个词元需要 17 或 18 比特。 然而，对于特定的具身任务而言，通常只需要一个高度受限的语义概念、动作、意图和协调命令的子集。 因此，这个庞大的通用词汇表可以被压缩为一种精简且适应任务的智能体语言，使智能体能够通过无线信道更高效地交换信息。 其次，与专注于点对点指标（如比特误码率和单次任务准确率）的传统无线系统不同，CEAI 更重视长期协作任务的完成。 因此，无线 TokCom 的性能应通过所传输的词元对推理、协调和任务成功的影响来评估，而不仅仅是通过词元恢复的准确性。 这要求我们转向一种以有效性为基准的新范式，将无线传输质量与具身多智能体协作的最终成果直接关联起来。

paragraphs.en: We provide an overview of CEAI and its associated communication paradigms, analyze the limitations of conventional bit-centric and SemCom paradigms, and introduce the emerging TokCom paradigm. Furthermore, we highlight how TokCom assists CEAI from three distinct perspectives: insight sharing, intent alignment, and interactive control.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 CEAI 及其相关的通信范式进行概述，分析传统以比特为中心的通信范式和 SemCom 范式的局限性，并介绍新兴的 TokCom 范式。 此外，我们还重点阐述了 TokCom 如何从三个不同视角助力 CEAI：洞察共享、意图对齐和交互式控制。

paragraphs.en: We propose a TokCom-assisted CEAI framework in which GFMs initialize a task-adaptive token protocol to align communication vocabularies among collaborating agents. During transmission, GFM-based encoders distill natural-language messages into compact token sequences for binary transmission before channel coding, and GFM-based decoders reconstruct them after reception, thereby facilitating efficient collaboration over wireless channels.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种由 TokCom 辅助的 CEAI 框架，其中 GFMs 会初始化一种任务自适应的标记协议，以协调协作智能体之间的通信词汇表。 在传输过程中，基于 GFM 的编码器会将自然语言消息提炼为紧凑的标记序列进行二进制传输，然后再进行信道编码；基于 GFM 的解码器则在接收后将其重构，从而促进无线信道上的高效协作。

paragraphs.en: CEAI is a decentralized paradigm in which multiple physical agents operate in a common environment, coordinating their actions to achieve collective goals. Different from passive AI, which relies on predictions over independent observations of the world, CEAI comprises active, embodied agents that deliberately perceive and interact with their environments to pursue explicit goals [ 8 ] . paragraphs.en: Quadruped Robots : These four-legged robots are designed for ground locomotion, capable of traversing complex and varied terrains.
paragraphs.zh: 四足机器人：这些四足机器人专为地面移动而设计，能够穿越复杂多样的地形。

paragraphs.en: Humanoid Robots : With a human-like form and inherent adaptability, these versatile robots can be deployed in a wide range of applications, often to perform tasks traditionally done by humans.
paragraphs.zh: 人形机器人：这类机器人具有类人形态和与生俱来的适应性，能够应用于多种场景，通常用于执行传统上由人类完成的任务。

paragraphs.en: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) : Categorized as either fixed-wing or rotary-wing, UAVs perceive their surroundings using cameras, light detection and ranging (LiDAR), and other sensors, adjusting their flight paths via propeller control.
paragraphs.zh: 无人飞行器（UAV）：可分为固定翼或旋翼两类，无人飞行器通过摄像头、光探测和测距（LiDAR）及其他传感器感知周围环境，并通过螺旋桨控制调整飞行路径。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous Vehicles : These agents exemplify the core principles of embodied intelligence by perceiving the dynamic traffic environment, making real-time decisions, and physically controlling the vehicle.
paragraphs.zh: 自动驾驶汽车：这些智能体通过感知动态的交通环境、做出实时决策以及物理控制车辆，体现了具身智能的核心原则。

paragraphs.en: These embodied agents support a wide range of applications. In smart manufacturing, they serve as mobile inspectors and precision operators for production monitoring, collaborative assembly, and hazardous material handling. In intelligent transportation, UAVs support aerial logistics, while autonomous vehicles enable passenger transport and safer road mobility. For public services, robots for service, inspection, and rescue assist in healthcare, infrastructure monitoring, environmental protection, and disaster response.
paragraphs.zh: 这些具身智能体支持广泛的应用场景。 在智能制造领域，它们可作为移动巡检员和精密操作者，用于生产监控、协作装配以及危险物料处理。 在智能交通领域，无人机支持空中物流，而自动驾驶汽车则实现乘客运输和更安全的道路出行。 在公共服务方面，用于服务、巡检和救援的机器人可协助医疗、基础设施监测、环境保护和灾害应对工作。

sents.en: These embodied agents support a wide range of applications.

paragraphs.en: Despite these diverse physical forms and applications, the core of CEAI is anchored by emerging GFMs [ 8 ] . Pretrained on large-scale multimodal data, GFMs provide the reasoning and generative capabilities that support the following core functions of CEAI agents:
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些物理形态和应用各不相同，但 CEAI 的核心仍由新兴的 GFM [8] 所支撑。 GFM 在大规模多模态数据上经过预训练，具备推理和生成能力，从而支持 CEAI 智能体的以下核心功能：

sents.en: Despite these diverse physical forms and applications, the core of CEAI is anchored by emerging GFMs [ 8 ] .
sents.zh: 尽管这些物理形态和应用各不相同，但 CEAI 的核心仍由新兴的 GFM [8] 所支撑。

sents.en: Pretrained on large-scale multimodal data, GFMs provide the reasoning and generative capabilities that support the following core functions of CEAI agents:
sents.zh: GFM 在大规模多模态数据上经过预训练，具备推理和生成能力，从而支持 CEAI 智能体的以下核心功能：

paragraphs.en: Perception : Agents perceive their environment through a range of modalities, such as visual, auditory, and tactile signals, and then interpret these observations to support memory, reasoning, communication and action.
paragraphs.zh: 感知：智能体通过多种模态（如视觉、听觉和触觉信号）感知其环境，然后对这些观察结果进行解读，以支持记忆、推理、沟通和行动。

paragraphs.en: Memory : Agents maintain and access a repository of information that includes, but is not limited to, their internal states, environmental contexts, and experiences.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆：智能体维护并访问一个信息库，该信息库包括（但不限于）其内部状态、环境上下文和经历。

paragraphs.en: Reasoning : Leveraging perception and memory, agents draw inferences, formulate plans, make decisions, and solve complex problems.
paragraphs.zh: 推理：通过利用感知和记忆，智能体能够进行推断、制定计划、做出决策并解决复杂问题。

paragraphs.en: Communication : Agents exchange information and coordinate with other agents to achieve collective goals.
paragraphs.zh: 通信：智能体之间交换信息，并与其他智能体协调合作，以实现共同目标。

paragraphs.en: Action : Agents execute physical tasks within their environment, such as navigation, grasping, and object manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 动作：智能体在环境中执行物理任务，例如导航、抓取和物体操控。

paragraphs.en: By combining these capabilities into a closed loop, CEAI translates physical interactions and multi-agent collaborations into experience-driven memory updates, continually evolving the agents for progressively deeper engagement with the physical world.
paragraphs.zh: 通过将这些能力整合为一个闭环，CEAI 将物理交互和多智能体协作转化为以经验驱动的记忆更新，从而持续进化智能体，使其能够与物理世界进行日益深入的互动。

paragraphs.en: Although individual agents possess diverse capabilities, they remain limited by partial observability and inherent physical boundaries. To overcome these individual limitations and tackle complex tasks requiring collective effort, effective multi-agent communication is indispensable [ 9 ] . It serves as the key mechanism that enables agents to share perceptions , exchange intentions , and coordinate actions , transforming isolated entities into a collaborative system. Generally, multi-agent communication research has evolved along two distinct paradigms:
paragraphs.zh: 尽管单个智能体具备多样化的能力，但它们仍然受到部分可观察性和内在物理边界的限制。 为了克服这些个体局限性并解决需要集体协作的复杂任务，有效的多智能体通信不可或缺 [ 9 ] 。 它是使智能体能够共享感知、交换意图和协调行动的关键机制，从而将孤立的个体转变为一个协作系统。 通常，多智能体通信研究沿着两种不同的范式发展：

sents.en: Although individual agents possess diverse capabilities, they remain limited by partial observability and inherent physical boundaries.
sents.zh: 尽管单个智能体具备多样化的能力，但它们仍然受到部分可观察性和内在物理边界的限制。

sents.en: To overcome these individual limitations and tackle complex tasks requiring collective effort, effective multi-agent communication is indispensable [ 9 ] .
sents.zh: 为了克服这些个体局限性并解决需要集体协作的复杂任务，有效的多智能体通信不可或缺 [ 9 ] 。

sents.en: It serves as the key mechanism that enables agents to share perceptions , exchange intentions , and coordinate actions , transforming isolated entities into a collaborative system.
sents.zh: 它是使智能体能够共享感知、交换意图和协调行动的关键机制，从而将孤立的个体转变为一个协作系统。

sents.en: Generally, multi-agent communication research has evolved along two distinct paradigms:
sents.zh: 通常，多智能体通信研究沿着两种不同的范式发展：

paragraphs.en: Bit-Centric Communication Paradigm: Rooted in the classical Shannon framework, this approach prioritizes reliable bit transmissions. However, for embodied agents equipped with data-intensive sensors, this strategy is often inefficient, necessitating the transmission of massive raw data volumes even for simple tasks [ 5 ] . Furthermore, the “cliff effect,” characterized by a sharp performance degradation under poor channel conditions, can be catastrophic for collaboration, particularly in complex electromagnetic environments. As a result, existing studies under this paradigm typically formulate the problem in terms of channel capacity or point-to-point reliability, without explicitly capturing how transmission errors propagate to subsequent collaborative processes.
paragraphs.zh: 以比特为中心的通信范式：这一方法植根于经典的香农框架，优先保证比特的可靠传输。 然而，对于配备数据密集型传感器的具身智能体而言，这种策略往往效率低下，即使执行简单任务也需要传输海量原始数据 [5]。 此外，“悬崖效应”——即在信道条件恶劣时性能急剧下降的现象——可能对协作造成灾难性影响，尤其是在复杂的电磁环境中。 因此，该范式下的现有研究通常从信道容量或点对点可靠性的角度来构建问题，但并未明确捕捉到传输错误如何传播至后续的协作过程。

sents.en: Bit-Centric Communication Paradigm: Rooted in the classical Shannon framework, this approach prioritizes reliable bit transmissions.
sents.zh: 以比特为中心的通信范式：这一方法植根于经典的香农框架，优先保证比特的可靠传输。

paragraphs.en: SemCom Paradigm: Shifting the focus from data fidelity to semantic fidelity, this paradigm prioritizes the accurate conveyance of meaning. By extracting and transmitting only essential, high-level information, it enhances spectral efficiency and resilience against channel noise [ 10 ] . Despite these advantages, current SemCom systems are typically highly specialized for specific tasks. Because their neural weights are statically bound to predefined downstream objectives, these systems require prohibitive retraining whenever the collaborative task changes. Consequently, they lack the generality required for CEAI, in which agents must process heterogeneous data modalities and execute diverse, complex collaborative tasks.
paragraphs.zh: SemCom 范式：该范式将重点从数据保真度转向语义保真度，优先确保意义的准确传达。 通过仅提取和传输关键的高层信息，它能提升频谱效率并增强对信道噪声的鲁棒性 [ 10 ] 。 尽管具有这些优势，当前的 SemCom 系统通常针对特定任务高度专业化。 由于它们的神经权重被静态绑定到预定义的下游目标上，因此每当协作任务发生变化时，这些系统都需要耗费巨大代价进行重新训练。 因此，它们缺乏 CEAI 所需的通用性，因为在 CEAI 中，智能体必须处理异构数据模态并执行多样化、复杂的协作任务。

sents.en: SemCom Paradigm: Shifting the focus from data fidelity to semantic fidelity, this paradigm prioritizes the accurate conveyance of meaning.
sents.zh: SemCom 范式：该范式将重点从数据保真度转向语义保真度，优先确保意义的准确传达。

sents.en: By extracting and transmitting only essential, high-level information, it enhances spectral efficiency and resilience against channel noise [ 10 ] .
sents.zh: 通过仅提取和传输关键的高层信息，它能提升频谱效率并增强对信道噪声的鲁棒性 [ 10 ] 。

sents.zh: 尽管具有这些优势，当前的 SemCom 系统通常针对特定任务高度专业化。

sents.en: Because their neural weights are statically bound to predefined downstream objectives, these systems require prohibitive retraining whenever the collaborative task changes.
sents.zh: 由于它们的神经权重被静态绑定到预定义的下游目标上，因此每当协作任务发生变化时，这些系统都需要耗费巨大代价进行重新训练。

sents.en: Consequently, they lack the generality required for CEAI, in which agents must process heterogeneous data modalities and execute diverse, complex collaborative tasks.
sents.zh: 因此，它们缺乏 CEAI 所需的通用性，因为在 CEAI 中，智能体必须处理异构数据模态并执行多样化、复杂的协作任务。

paragraphs.en: While these paradigms provide a foundation for current communication systems, they remain insufficient for CEAI, as communications in embodied multi-agent systems must address the following challenges:
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些范式为当前的通信系统提供了基础，但它们对于 CEAI 而言仍然不足，因为在具身多智能体系统中的通信必须应对以下挑战：

paragraphs.en: Multimodal Grounding: Embodied agents perceive the physical world through multimodal data from heterogeneous sensors. Consequently, communications must represent and transmit information grounded in multiple modalities. Crucially, this requires cross-modal alignment capabilities, such as translating visual observations into linguistic descriptions or converting language instructions into executable actions.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态接地：具身智能体通过来自异构传感器的多模态数据感知物理世界。 因此，通信必须表示和传输基于多种模态的信息。 至关重要的是，这需要跨模态对齐能力，例如将视觉观察转化为语言描述，或将语言指令转换为可执行动作。

sents.en: Multimodal Grounding: Embodied agents perceive the physical world through multimodal data from heterogeneous sensors.
sents.zh: 多模态接地：具身智能体通过来自异构传感器的多模态数据感知物理世界。

sents.en: Consequently, communications must represent and transmit information grounded in multiple modalities.
sents.zh: 因此，通信必须表示和传输基于多种模态的信息。

sents.en: Crucially, this requires cross-modal alignment capabilities, such as translating visual observations into linguistic descriptions or converting language instructions into executable actions.
sents.zh: 至关重要的是，这需要跨模态对齐能力，例如将视觉观察转化为语言描述，或将语言指令转换为可执行动作。

paragraphs.en: Task-Oriented Effectiveness: CEAI prioritizes long-horizon task completion over point-to-point transmission performance. From the Shannon-Weaver perspective, this requirement corresponds to the effectiveness level of communication, namely whether the received information leads to desired actions and outcomes. Accordingly, at the effectiveness level, the value of transmitted information should be measured by its ultimate contribution to collaborative task success, rather than solely by semantic fidelity [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 任务导向的有效性：CEAI 更重视长期任务的完成，而非点对点传输性能。 从香农-韦弗模型的角度来看，这一要求对应于通信的有效性层面，即接收到的信息是否促成了预期的行动和结果。 因此，在有效性层面，所传输信息的价值应通过其对协作任务成功的最终贡献来衡量，而不应仅依据语义保真度 [ 11 ] 。

sents.zh: 任务导向的有效性：CEAI 更重视长期任务的完成，而非点对点传输性能。

paragraphs.en: In Transformer-based GFMs, tokens are the elementary units for sequence modeling and are internally mapped to embedding vectors. Text tokens are typically discrete vocabulary indices, whereas visual, audio, or control-related tokens may be represented either as discrete codebook entries or as continuous embeddings. Through tokenization, raw multimodal data are converted into token sequences that preserve task-relevant features and semantics, making them suitable for processing by GFMs.
paragraphs.zh: 在基于 Transformer 的 GFM 中，token 是序列建模的基本单位，并在内部被映射为嵌入向量。 文本 token 通常是离散的词汇表索引，而视觉、音频或与控制相关的 token 既可以表示为离散的码本条目，也可以表示为连续嵌入。 通过分词，原始多模态数据被转换为 token 序列，这些序列保留了任务相关的特征和语义，从而适合由 GFM 处理。

paragraphs.en: TokCom represents a paradigm shift by leveraging these tokens as the primary information carriers [ 7 ] . Unlike traditional paradigms that transmit raw signals or engineered features, agents in this framework leverage GFMs to generate tokens for transmission and to directly process received tokens for downstream reasoning and action. TokCom offers distinct advantages for CEAI:

paragraphs.en: In this section, we discuss how TokCom supports CEAI collaboration across three layers: insight sharing at the perception layer, intent alignment at the reasoning layer, and interactive control at the execution layer, as illustrated in Fig. 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将探讨 TokCom 如何在三个层面上支持 CEAI 协作：感知层的洞察共享、推理层的目标对齐以及执行层的交互式控制，如图 2 所示。

paragraphs.en: TokCom first helps agents overcome sensory heterogeneity and partial observability by transforming local observations into shareable task-relevant insights.
paragraphs.zh: TokCom 首先通过将局部观察转化为可共享的任务相关洞察，帮助智能体克服感知异质性和部分可观测性。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal Insight Representation: Embodied agents rely on heterogeneous sensors and may observe different aspects of the same environment. By representing sensory information as tokens, TokCom provides a common interface through which agents can exchange observations across modalities, such as visual, auditory, LiDAR, or tactile information. This enables agents to build a shared semantic ground for collaboration.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态洞察表示：具身智能体依赖异构传感器，并可能观察到同一环境的不同方面。 通过将感官信息表示为标记，TokCom 提供了一个通用接口，使智能体能够跨模态交换观察结果，例如视觉、听觉、LiDAR 或触觉信息。 这使得智能体能够为协作建立共享的语义基础。

A transmitting agent can distill local observations into receiver-relevant token sequences, reducing the need to transmit raw sensory data. The receiving agent can then integrate tokens from multiple peers with its own local memory, forming a more complete understanding of the environment under bandwidth-limited conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 协作感知融合：TokCom 还支持分布式感知的融合。 一个传输智能体可以将局部观测信息提炼为与接收方相关的标记序列，从而减少传输原始感官数据的必要性。 随后，接收智能体可以将来自多个同伴的标记与其自身的局部记忆相整合，在带宽受限的情况下形成对环境更完整的理解。

paragraphs.en: Beyond sharing insights, effective CEAI requires agents to align their high-level intents prior to interactive control. TokCom encapsulates such intents into concise token sequences, facilitating alignment at two complementary levels: synchronizing global goals and negotiating local roles.

paragraphs.en: Primitive Directive Generation: TokCom can transmit compact tokens that represent parameterized action primitives, such as approach, grasp, or move. paragraphs.en: As shown in Part A of Fig. 3 , each CEAI agent consists of five interconnected modules, namely perception, memory, reasoning, communication, and action, all built around a GFM core. paragraphs.en: While Section III showed that TokCom can support insight sharing, intent alignment, and interactive control in CEAI, directly transmitting token sequences generated by GFMs poses severe challenges for practical wireless deployment. In real-world scenarios, distributed CEAI agents must communicate over wireless links characterized by stringent bandwidth constraints and time-varying channel fading. However, pretrained GFM tokenizers are fundamentally optimized for inference and generation rather than communication. Being agnostic to wireless constraints, they lack mechanisms to minimize transmission payloads or ensure semantic robustness against channel impairments. This mismatch between inference-oriented tokenization and wireless transmission requirements leads to two major inefficiencies:

paragraphs.en: Sequence-Level Redundancy and Ambiguity: At the sequence level, GFM-generated natural language tends to retain redundant lexical, syntactic, or multimodal details that are unnecessary for physical execution, thereby inflating the transmission payload [ 10 ] . Furthermore, the same physical phenomenon or task intent can be expressed by highly varied token sequences. This descriptive inconsistency risks introducing ambiguity, as receiving agents may interpret the varied sequences differently, hindering precise coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 序列级冗余与歧义：在序列层面，GFM生成的自然语言往往保留冗余的词汇、句法或多模态细节，而这些细节对于物理执行并无必要，从而增加了传输负载 [ 10 ] 。 此外，相同的物理现象或任务意图可以通过差异极大的词元序列来表达。 这种描述上的不一致性可能引发歧义，因为接收智能体可能对不同的序列产生不同解读，进而阻碍精确协调。

paragraphs.en: These observations suggest that pretrained GFM tokenizers are effective for inference and generation, but not well suited to wireless communication and collaboration. paragraphs.en: To address the above challenges, we propose a TokCom-assisted CEAI framework, illustrated in Parts B and C of Fig. 3 . The central idea is to insert a task-adaptive protocol layer between GFM reasoning and wireless transmission, translating reasoning-oriented natural language into a compact, transmission-efficient agent language. Specifically, the agents first establish a shared task-adaptive communication protocol, and then use this protocol to guide semantic compression and reconstruction during message exchange. In this way, communication is shifted from general-purpose to task-oriented token transmission, thereby improving both efficiency and robustness over wireless links.

paragraphs.en: Before a collaborative task begins, a cloud server or an elected coordinator can use a GFM to generate a shared, task-adaptive TokCom protocol and distribute it to all agents. Recent GFM-driven agent systems have begun to adopt explicit communication protocols, such as the model context protocol (MCP) and the agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol, to structure interactions among agents, tools, and environments [ 13 ] . In contrast to such general software-level protocols, the proposed TokCom protocol is tailored to wireless CEAI by defining task-adaptive semantic primitives, syntax rules, and compact protocol-token IDs. Rather than relying on a universal fixed protocol, this protocol can be generated or adapted according to the task information, agent capabilities, and environmental context. It therefore serves as a task-oriented communication interface rather than a general-purpose one. In the following, we refer to the semantic primitives defined by this protocol as protocol tokens . Each protocol token is assigned a compact protocol-token identifier (ID) for binary transmission, distinguishing it from the general-purpose GFM tokens produced by pretrained tokenizers. These protocol tokens are generated for the current task and environment rather than selected from the pretrained GFM vocabulary according to token frequency. paragraphs.en: Task-Adaptive Codebook. The protocol includes a compact set of protocol tokens, each corresponding to a semantic primitive such as an object, action, state, or spatial concept. Compared with the general-purpose GFM tokenizer, the task-adaptive codebook retains only task-relevant semantics, thereby substantially reducing the number of source bits required per transmitted token. For example, if the task-adaptive codebook contains no more than 32 32 protocol tokens, each protocol-token ID requires only 5 5 source bits, i.e., ⌈ log 2 ⁡ 32 ⌉ = 5 \lceil\log_{2}32\rceil=5 . At the same time, each protocol token is associated with a precise meaning, which suppresses variability and ambiguity in expression. In a collaborative object-transport task, for example, the codebook may include protocol tokens for key objects (e.g., “apple” and “banana”), actions (e.g., “grasp” and “move”), and states (e.g., “found” and “clear”). By restricting the codebook to these essential task-relevant elements, agents can communicate more efficiently and with less ambiguity.

sents.en: Once the task-adaptive protocol is established, each agent adopts a protocol-based encoding and decoding pipeline during communication.
sents.zh: 一旦任务自适应协议建立，每个智能体在通信过程中都会采用基于协议的编码和解码流程。

sents.en: As illustrated in Part C of Fig. 3 , the communication flow includes five stages: message generation, protocol-based semantic distillation, binary mapping of protocol-token IDs, wireless transmission, and semantic reconstruction from received protocol tokens.
sents.zh: 如图 3 的 C 部分所示，通信流程包括五个阶段：消息生成、基于协议的语义蒸馏、协议令牌 ID 的二进制映射、无线传输以及从接收到的协议令牌中重构语义。

sents.en: This pipeline is tightly integrated into the GFM-centered cognition–action loop, so that decoded messages can be directly used by the GFM for subsequent reasoning and action generation.
sents.zh: 该流程与以 GFM 为核心的认知-行动循环紧密集成，使得解码后的消息能够被 GFM 直接用于后续的推理和行动生成。

paragraphs.en: Transmitter Side. When an agent decides to transmit a message, it first generates a raw natural-language message that conveys the intended semantics but may contain redundant wording or task-irrelevant details. Instead of directly tokenizing this message with the general-purpose tokenizer of the GFM, the agent employs a GFM-based encoder to distill it into several protocol tokens. Specifically, the raw message and the shared protocol are formatted as the input to the GFM, and the output is constrained to contain only codewords defined in the protocol. In this way, the transmitted tokens remain semantically relevant, compact, and fully compliant with the shared protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 发送方。 当一个智能体决定发送消息时，它会先生成一个原始自然语言消息，该消息传达了预期的语义，但可能包含冗余措辞或与任务无关的细节。 智能体不会直接使用 GFM 的通用分词器对该消息进行分词，而是采用基于 GFM 的编码器将其提炼为几个协议令牌。 具体来说，原始消息和共享协议会被格式化为 GFM 的输入，而输出则被限制为仅包含协议中定义的编码词。 通过这种方式，发送的令牌在保持语义相关性的同时，既简洁又完全符合共享协议。

paragraphs.en: Receiver Side. After wireless transmission, some protocol tokens may be received correctly, erased, or marked as unreliable due to channel noise. The receiver therefore combines the received tokens with the shared protocol and its local memory in a GFM-based decoder to recover the intended semantics. The decoder converts the received tokens, whether clean or corrupted, into a message suitable for downstream reasoning. For example, in Part C of Fig. 3 , a protocol token corresponding to a room name is corrupted during transmission. By leveraging the protocol together with contextual memory, such as dialogue history and action history, the receiver can infer that the missing token denotes a location and estimate the transmitter’s likely current room.
paragraphs.zh: 接收端。 无线传输后，由于信道噪声，某些协议令牌可能被正确接收、被擦除，或标记为不可靠。 因此，接收端将接收到的令牌与共享协议及其本地内存结合，通过基于 GFM 的解码器恢复预期的语义。 解码器将接收到的令牌（无论是否干净或已损坏）转换为适合下游推理的消息。 例如，在图 3 的 C 部分中，一个对应房间名称的协议令牌在传输过程中被损坏了。 通过利用协议以及上下文记忆（如对话历史和动作历史），接收端可以推断出缺失的令牌表示一个位置，并估计发送端当前可能所在的房间。

paragraphs.en: Environment and Task: We evaluate the proposed framework on the ThreeDWorld object-transport benchmark [ 14 ] . Fig. 4 Part A shows a representative simulation environment, including the multi-room house layout, target objects, and optional containers. Two embodied agents collaboratively search for these objects and transport them to a designated goal location, optionally using the containers to improve efficiency. Both agents have identical capabilities, including egocentric RGB-D perception, autonomous navigation, object manipulation, and message transmission. Following the modular design in [ 15 ] , RGB-D observations are converted into text by a perception module, and this conversion is assumed to perfectly preserve the semantics of the RGB-D images. The same design can be extended to arbitrary modalities by converting each modality into text through a similar module. They are initialized at different locations with partially observable fields of view, making communication useful for coordinating exploration and avoiding redundant or conflicting actions. We evaluate 24 24 task instances, including 12 12 food scenarios and 12 12 stuff scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 环境与任务：我们在 ThreeDWorld 物体运输基准 [14] 上评估了所提出的框架。 图 4A 展示了一个典型的模拟环境，包括多房间的房屋布局、目标物体以及可选的容器。 两个具身智能体协同寻找这些物体，并将其运送到指定的目标位置，必要时可以使用容器来提高效率。 两个智能体的能力完全相同，包括以自我为中心的 RGB-D 感知、自主导航、物体操控和信息传输。 遵循 [15] 中的模块化设计，RGB-D 观测数据由一个感知模块转换为文本，并假设这种转换能够完美保留 RGB-D 图像的语义信息。 通过用类似的模块将每种模态转换为文本，该设计可以扩展到任意模态。 它们从不同位置开始初始化，且视野仅部分可观测，因此通信有助于协调探索过程，避免重复或冲突的动作。 我们评估了 24 个任务实例，包括 12 个食物场景和 12 个物品场景。

paragraphs.en: Model and Communication Setup: We use the instruction-tuned Gemma 4 31B Dense model 1 1 1 Google DeepMind, “Gemma 4 Model Card,” https://ai.google.dev/gemma/docs/core/model_card_4 , accessed Jun. 17, 2026. as the text-only GFM backbone for agent reasoning and communication. The model is frozen and used only for inference. It is neither trained from scratch nor fine-tuned. Protocol initialization, encoding, and decoding are realized by in-context prompting with the default sampling configuration. We deploy the model on two NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPUs, where the measured generation throughput is 35.83 35.83 output tokens/s and the GPU memory footprint is about 45.4 45.4 GB. These figures depend on the hardware, quantization scheme, and cache configuration, and they characterize our setup rather than hardware-independent properties of the method. A lighter GFM capable of following the shared protocol can replace the current backbone to reduce computational cost. At each simulation step, the GFM selects from feasible high-level actions, such as searching the current room, picking up an object, navigating to a location, or sending a message. For Conventional TokCom, natural-language messages are directly tokenized by Gemma 4’s default tokenizer, and the resulting token indices are mapped into binary payloads for transmission. For Protocol-Guided TokCom, agents initialize a task-adaptive protocol at the beginning of each task and exchange compact protocol-token IDs instead of full vocabulary indices. Both schemes use fixed-length token-ID mapping without entropy coding. In the noisy-channel evaluation, they share the same digital communication chain, consisting of a rate-1/2 convolutional code, quadrature phase shift keying (QPSK) modulation, and soft-decision Viterbi decoding.

paragraphs.en: Transport Steps (TS): The cumulative number of simulation steps required to transport all target objects to the designated goal, where fewer steps indicate higher task efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 运输步数（TS）：将所有目标对象运输至指定目标所需的模拟步骤总数，步数越少表示任务效率越高。

paragraphs.en: Bit Consumption (BC): The total number of source-side payload bits generated by tokenizing or protocol-encoding all agent-to-agent messages before channel coding, excluding channel-coding redundancy and packet headers. Protocol initialization overhead is not included in BC, since the generated protocol can be reused over many communication rounds. BC therefore measures subsequent message payloads after a shared protocol is available. When agents use the same GFM with a fixed random seed and a common sampling configuration, they can generate an identical protocol locally from the shared task context, so the protocol itself need not be transmitted. This excluded overhead becomes more significant for short tasks or frequent protocol regeneration.
paragraphs.zh: 比特消耗（BC）：在信道编码之前，通过将所有智能体间消息进行分词或协议编码所生成的源端有效载荷比特的总数，不包括信道编码冗余和包头。 协议初始化开销不包含在 BC 中，因为生成的协议可以在多个通信轮次中重复使用。 因此，BC 衡量的是在共享协议可用之后后续消息的有效载荷。 当智能体使用相同的 GFM、固定的随机种子和共同的采样配置时，它们可以从共享的任务上下文中本地生成完全相同的协议，因此无需传输协议本身。 对于短任务或频繁重新生成协议的情况，这种被排除的开销会变得更加显著。

paragraphs.en: Baselines and Proposed Method: We compare three schemes:
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法与所提方法：我们比较了三种方案：

paragraphs.en: No Comm.: Agents operate independently without any inter-agent communication, serving as a non-communication reference.
paragraphs.zh: 无通信：智能体独立运行，不进行任何智能体间通信，作为非通信参考。

paragraphs.en: Conventional TokCom: Agents generate natural-language messages with the GFM and directly transmit the corresponding pretrained-token indices. Upon reception, the recovered message is fed into the receiver’s GFM for inference.
paragraphs.zh: 传统 TokCom：智能体使用 GFM 生成自然语言消息，并直接传输对应的预训练词元索引。 接收到消息后，恢复的消息会被送入接收方的 GFM 进行推理。

sents.en: Conventional TokCom: Agents generate natural-language messages with the GFM and directly transmit the corresponding pretrained-token indices.
sents.zh: 传统 TokCom：智能体使用 GFM 生成自然语言消息，并直接传输对应的预训练词元索引。

sents.en: Upon reception, the recovered message is fed into the receiver’s GFM for inference.

paragraphs.en: Protocol-Guided TokCom (Proposed): Agents initialize a task-adaptive protocol, distill natural-language messages into compact protocol-token sequences, and reconstruct actionable semantics from received protocol tokens.

paragraphs.en: Protocol-Guided TokCom achieves step reductions comparable to Conventional TokCom, suggesting that the task-adaptive protocol preserves coordination-critical semantics. In preliminary trials, simply asking a GFM to compress messages without a shared protocol did not reliably improve TS. Although the transmitted text became shorter, compressed expressions generated by one agent could be ambiguous to another agent, because the agents did not share an explicit codebook or syntax for interpreting the compressed tokens. In contrast, Protocol-Guided TokCom constrains both agents to a common set of semantic primitives and composition rules, making compressed messages more consistently interpretable.
paragraphs.zh: 协议引导的令牌通信（Protocol-Guided TokCom）实现的步骤减少幅度与传统令牌通信（Conventional TokCom）相当，这表明任务自适应协议保留了协调关键的含义。 在初步试验中，仅要求 GFM 在没有共享协议的情况下压缩消息，并未能可靠地提升 TS。 尽管传输的文本变短了，但一个智能体生成的压缩表达可能对另一个智能体产生歧义，因为这两个智能体并未共享用于解释压缩令牌的明确编码表或句法。 相比之下，协议引导的令牌通信（Protocol-Guided TokCom）将两个智能体都限制在共同的语义原语和组合规则集合内，使压缩消息能够被更一致地解读。

paragraphs.en: The communication saving comes from semantic distillation and compact protocol indexing. Semantic distillation reduces the number of transmitted tokens by removing task-irrelevant wording, while compact protocol indexing maps each protocol token to a small ID instead of an index in the full GFM vocabulary. Without the protocol, agents transmit an average of 476.08 476.08 tokens per episode; with the protocol, this drops to 78.88 78.88 tokens, corresponding to a reduction of 83.43 % 83.43\% . Since the task-adaptive codebook contains only about 22 22 to 28 28 protocol tokens, each protocol-token ID requires 5 5 bits, compared with 18 18 bits for Gemma 4’s general-purpose tokenizer. Together, these two factors reduce the total source payload to about 5 % 5\% of that required by Conventional TokCom while achieving comparable transport efficiency, as shown in Fig. 4 Part B(c).
paragraphs.zh: 通信量的节省源于语义蒸馏和紧凑协议索引。 语义蒸馏通过移除与任务无关的措辞来减少传输的标记数量，而紧凑协议索引则将每个协议标记映射为一个小型 ID，而非完整 GFM 词汇表中的一个索引。 在没有协议的情况下，智能体每轮平均传输 476.08 个标记；使用协议后，这一数字降至 78.88 个标记，降幅为 83.43%。 由于任务自适应码本仅包含约 22 至 28 个协议标记，每个协议标记的 ID 需要 5 位，而 Gemma 4 的通用分词器则需要 18 位。 这两个因素共同将总源数据负载减少到传统 TokCom 所需负载的大约 5%，同时实现了相当高的传输效率，如图 4 的 B(c) 部分所示。

paragraphs.en: We further conduct a preliminary noisy-channel evaluation over an additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channel. Following the token-erasure abstraction used in TokCom studies [ 7 ] , protocol-token IDs detected as unreliable after channel decoding are replaced by [MASKED] , so this evaluation characterizes robustness to token erasures. In practical systems, such erasures can be obtained through token-level cyclic redundancy checks, confidence-based demodulation, or packet-level error detection. Undetected substitutions would be more challenging than erasures, because the received tokens are not marked as unreliable. Guided by the shared protocol and context, the GFM may still detect or correct some inaccurate tokens, but task performance may degrade. Both schemes adopt the same masking strategy. The token error rate (TER) is computed as the fraction of transmitted protocol-token IDs marked unreliable before GFM-based semantic reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步在加性高斯白噪声（AWGN）信道上进行初步的噪声信道评估。 遵循 TokCom 研究 [7] 中使用的令牌擦除抽象方法，在信道解码后被检测为不可靠的协议令牌 ID 会被替换为 [MASKED]，因此该评估可表征对令牌擦除的鲁棒性。 在实际系统中，此类擦除可以通过令牌级的循环冗余校验、基于置信度的解调或数据包级的错误检测来实现。 未检测到的替换将比擦除更具挑战性，因为接收到的令牌并未被标记为不可靠。 在共享协议和上下文的指导下，GFM 可能仍能检测或纠正某些不准确的令牌，但任务性能可能会下降。 两种方案均采用了相同的掩码策略。 令牌错误率（TER）的计算方式为：在被 GFM 基于语义的重建之前，被标记为不可靠的已传输协议令牌 ID 所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: The protocol structure makes erasure recovery more constrained. Since valid tokens come from a compact task-adaptive codebook, the decoder searches over a much smaller protocol-token space than the full GFM vocabulary. Syntax rules and neighboring protocol tokens can further indicate the missing token type, such as object, action, location, or state. The receiver can then combine this type constraint with local memory, dialogue history, and action history to infer the missing semantics more effectively.
paragraphs.zh: 该协议结构使得擦除恢复受到更多限制。 由于有效令牌来自紧凑的任务自适应码本，解码器搜索的协议令牌空间远小于完整的 GFM 词汇表。 句法规则和相邻的协议令牌可以进一步指示缺失的令牌类型，例如对象、动作、位置或状态。 接收方随后可以将这种类型约束与本地记忆、对话历史和动作历史相结合，从而更有效地推断出缺失的语义。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 Parts B(d) and B(e) show sentence similarity and TS versus signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). As the SNR increases from 0 0 dB to 2 2 dB, TER drops sharply from 0.60 0.60 to 0.03 0.03 , and TS decreases accordingly. When the SNR reaches 2 2 dB or higher, the average TS stabilizes and matches the error-free case. This suggests that exact sentence recovery is not always necessary, as long as coordination-critical semantics can still be inferred. Overall, the case study illustrates the potential robustness of task-adaptive protocols for wireless CEAI.

paragraphs.en: Due to the discrete nature of codebooks, TokCom relies on discrete protocol-token ID transmission, which poses challenges in low-SNR regimes. Joint source-channel coding (JSCC) improves robustness through end-to-end training by jointly optimizing source and channel encoding. Future work should explore lightweight neural networks adapted to specific communication scenarios, incorporating task information, protocol constraints, and channel statistics to improve resilience in noisy wireless environments. For example, meta-learning can be used to initialize a lightweight JSCC model that can rapidly adapt to new tasks and channel conditions with minimal additional training.
paragraphs.zh: 由于码本的离散特性，TokCom 依赖离散协议令牌 ID 的传输，这在低信噪比（SNR）条件下带来了挑战。 联合信源-信道编码（JSCC）通过端到端训练，对信源和信道编码进行联合优化，从而提升了系统的鲁棒性。 未来的研究应探索适用于特定通信场景的轻量级神经网络，通过整合任务信息、协议约束和信道统计特性，提升其在嘈杂无线环境中的抗干扰能力。 例如，元学习可用于初始化一个轻量级的 JSCC 模型，使其能够在最小额外训练的情况下快速适应新任务和新的信道条件。

paragraphs.en: Agents may discover new objects during task execution that are unanticipated during protocol initialization. Thus, a dynamic protocol update mechanism is essential for sustained collaboration. Future research should investigate methods for efficiently integrating newly discovered semantic primitives into the current protocol with minimal overhead, while maintaining coherent multi-agent coordination across environmental changes.

paragraphs.en: The proposed framework assumes that agents use compatible GFM implementations for encoding and decoding. However, heterogeneous agents may employ different model architectures, training procedures, or quantization schemes. Future work should investigate protocol mechanisms enabling interoperability across diverse GFM implementations, develop robust decoding strategies tolerant to model variations, and establish formal verification methods that ensure semantic consistency across heterogeneous agent populations.

sents.en: Future work should investigate protocol mechanisms enabling interoperability across diverse GFM implementations, develop robust decoding strategies tolerant to model variations, and establish formal verification methods that ensure semantic consistency across heterogeneous agent populations.
sents.zh: 未来的工作应研究能够在不同 GFM 实现之间实现互操作的协议机制，开发能够容忍模型差异的稳健解码策略，并建立形式化验证方法，以确保异构智能体群体之间的语义一致性。

paragraphs.en: This article investigated TokCom-assisted CEAI for efficient and task-effective collaboration among embodied agents over wireless networks. We first discussed how TokCom supports CEAI through insight sharing, intent alignment, and interactive control. To address the overhead and ambiguity of directly transmitting pretrained GFM tokens, we proposed a task-adaptive protocol-guided framework with compact protocol tokens, syntax rules, and GFM-based semantic distillation and reconstruction. The case study suggests that protocol-guided TokCom can substantially reduce source payload bit consumption while largely preserving collaborative task performance under token erasures. Future advances in channel-aware token coding, dynamic protocol adaptation, and heterogeneous GFM interoperability will be important for practical deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 本文研究了由 TokCom 辅助的 CEAI，旨在实现具身智能体在无线网络中高效且任务导向的合作。 我们首先探讨了 TokCom 如何通过洞察共享、意图对齐和交互控制来支持 CEAI。 为了解决直接传输预训练 GFM 标记所带来的开销和模糊性问题，我们提出了一种任务自适应的协议引导框架，该框架包含紧凑的协议标记、句法规则以及基于 GFM 的语义蒸馏与重构。 案例研究表明，在发生标记丢失的情况下，协议引导的 TokCom 能够显著减少源数据负载的比特消耗，同时基本保持协作任务的性能。 未来在信道感知标记编码、动态协议自适应以及异构 GFM 互操作性方面的进展，对于实际部署将至关重要。
